target: Teach another learner to reason about sandboxed learning using an isolated candidate-training environment. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

competency.title: Teach sandboxed learning — human review
competency.outcome: Teach another learner to reason about sandboxed learning using an isolated candidate-training environment. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: allowing training code to read private tests

competency.practice_task: Produce a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test grounded in an isolated candidate-training environment.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.
required_evidence: a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test
Include reviewer notes, disagreement resolution and audit trail.
Report containment and artifact provenance with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: allowing training code to read private tests.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of sandboxed learning.
Practice: the learner succeeds on a new case without the answer key.
Measurement: report containment and artifact provenance against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for allowing training code to read private tests; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
